chunks: From him, from a number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Yaqoub ibn Yazid, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Ibn Udhaynahh, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him)
regarding the saying of the Exalted: 'Nowhere is there a secret counsel between three persons but He is the fourth of them, nor (between) five but He is the sixth of them'

So he said: 'He is the One, uniquely singular in Essence, separate from His creation; and with that He described Himself. He encompasses everything through supervision, encompassment, and power. Nothing escapes from Him — not even the weight of an atom in the heavens nor in the earth, nor anything smaller than that nor larger — through encompassment and knowledge, not through His Essence, because places are limited, contained by four boundaries, and if it were through His Essence, it would necessitate His being contained (within those limits).'

key_terms.الْإِحَاطَةِ: Encompassment — the quality of surrounding and pervading all things in terms of knowledge and control, not physical presence.
key_terms.الْإِشْرَافِ: Supervision/overseeing — one of three modes by which God encompasses creation, referring to His complete oversight of all affairs.
key_terms.الْحَوَايَةُ: Containment — the logical implication being negated: if God were present through His Essence in physical space, He would be contained by the limits of that space.
key_terms.بَائِنٌ مِنْ خَلْقِهِ: Separate from His creation — affirming divine transcendence (tanzih) and rejecting any form of union (ittihad) or incarnation (hulul) of God within creation.
key_terms.بِالذَّاتِ: Through the Self/Essence — the mode of presence that is specifically denied; God is not omnipresent by physically inhabiting all spaces.
key_terms.وَاحِدِيُّ الذَّاتِ: Uniquely singular in Essence — a philosophical assertion that God's unity is not merely numerical but ontological; His Essence admits no division, multiplicity, or likeness.

ai.seo_question: How does Imam al-Sadiq explain the meaning of Quran 58:7 about God being present with people in secret counsel?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) provides an authoritative theological interpretation of Quran 58:7, which describes God as being present with any group of people in secret counsel. The Imam draws a crucial distinction between two modes of omnipresence: physical presence through the divine Essence (Dhat), and knowledge-based presence through supervision and encompassment. He firmly negates the former, explaining that spatial presence would logically entail God being contained and limited by the four-directional boundaries that define physical spaces. This hadith is a key text in Shia kalam (theology) on the nature of divine omniscience versus spatial transcendence, emphasizing that God's being 'with' creation is a matter of His all-encompassing knowledge and power, not physical immanence or indwelling.

en.hubeali:
From him, from a number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Yaqoub Bin Yazeed, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Ibn Azina,
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>
regarding the Words of the Exalted [58:7] Nowhere is there a secret counsel occurring between three persons but He is the fourth of them, nor (between) five but He is the sixth of them.

So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘He<sup>azwj</sup> is the One, One of the Self separate from His<sup>azwj</sup> creatures, and with that He<sup>azwj</sup> Described Himself<sup>azwj</sup>, and He<sup>azwj</sup> Encompasses everything by the Supervision, and the Control, and the Power. Nothing escapes from Him<sup>azwj</sup>, (even if it is) an atom’s weight in the skies nor in the earth, nor anything smaller than that, nor bigger, due to the Control. And the Knowledge is not with the Self because the places are limited by the extent of its four limits. So when that was with the Self, the calling would necessitate it’.
en.sarwar: 5. It is narrated from him (the narrator of the above Haddith) from a group of our people from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid from ya‘qub ibn yazid from ibn abu ‘Umayr from ibn ’Udhaynah from Imam abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) who has said the following.

It is about the words of Allah “There is not a single place wherein any secret counsel can take place between any three people without God being the fourth, nor five people without His being the sixth. .” [58:7].

“He is One, the One only in His Own-self. He is different from His creatures and as such He has said about His Own-Self. He has control over all things through His presence, control and power. Nothing as small as an atom in the heavens or earth is absent from Him, not even things smaller or bigger. It is all through His control and knowledge not by His-self. It is because the places are limited by the four boundaries. If it would be by His-self it would limit Him.” About the words of Allah The Beneficent God is dominant over the Throne (of the realm) [20:5]
